author: floryking

notes: Free-standing 3D letters on the cruise pier at Bridgetown port, each letter painted with palm trees, dancers and surfers in blue, green and yellow, which breaks up the letter shapes. Distractor: 'RHAPSODY OF THE SEAS / NASSAU' on the stern of the cruise ship behind (vehicle name).

author: Captmondo
attribution: Photo: Captmondo, CC BY-SA 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:MountGayRum-SignInFrontOfBuilding-March12-09.JPG. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Roadside sign in front of the Mount Gay bottling plant and visitor centre, Saint Lucy. Crest logo at left (with tiny 'MOUNT GAY'), small 'MOUNT GAY RUM BARBADOS' logo in the bottom panel. A second identical face is seen edge-on at left (distractor). Razor wire in the foreground.

author: Djr xi
attribution: Photo: Djr xi, CC BY-SA 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Welcome_to_Combermere.JPG. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Blue painted letters on a white board above the scoreboard of Combermere School's cricket ground, Barbados, seen from below. The black scoreboard below shows a cut-off '1stINNINGS' (distractor).

author: CaribDigita
attribution: Photo: CaribDigita, Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:The_Barbados_Yacht_Club_sign.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/mark/1.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Gold raised letters on a coral-stone wall at the club's main entrance, Bay Street, Bridgetown. The orange '1 12 '00' in the lower right is a film-camera date imprint, not sign text.

author: CaribDigita
attribution: Photo: CaribDigita, Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Inter-American_Dev-Bank_sign,_Barbados.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/mark/1.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Stone plaque with the IDB globe emblem on a white boundary wall of the bank's Barbados country office on Highway 7; the carved lettering is thin and low-contrast (brownish on cream). Film scan with slight grain.

author: CaribDigita
attribution: Photo: CaribDigita, Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Sign_for_Saint_Lawrence_Gap,_Christ_Church.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/mark/1.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Large rough-cast 3D letters on a wall at the western end of St Lawrence Gap, Christ Church, where it meets Highway 7; irregular stylised letters, half in shadow, low-resolution phone photo. 'St' is written with a small t. After 'GA' the final P is not visible (out of frame or missing). Distractors: a partly hidden hotel sign and a '...illage' arrow sign at far left, blue 'WAY' arrow sign at left edge.
source_title: File:Sign for Saint Lawrence Gap, Christ Church.jpg

author: CaribDigita
attribution: Photo: CaribDigita, Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Sign_of_the_Barbados,_Courtyard_Marriott.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/mark/1.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Free-standing hotel monument sign on Highway 7, Christ Church. Behind it, gold script letters on the brick wall ('The B... Pavili...') are mostly hidden by the sign and a palm trunk: distractor, not transcribed.
source_title: File:Sign of the Barbados, Courtyard Marriott.jpg

author: Unionville
attribution: Photo: Unionville, CC0 1.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Royal_Barbados_Yacht_Club_Sign.jpg. License: http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/deed.en. Unmodified original.
notes: Historic cast sign with the club burgee, now mounted on an interior wall; frontal and sharp. Different physical sign from c10949834 (same club). The small wooden plaque below explaining the sign's history is too small to read reliably and is not transcribed.
